shared_tail.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد

notes: «جميعا عن» converges three routes: each is its own group, and the text writes the common tail once (rule 3).
«محمد، بن جعفر» with its comma is one man (rule 7). The editor glosses «- قال أبو بكر حدثنا غندر -» and «- رضى الله عنهما -» are left out; the gloss does not add a route.
